description.promeva:title: Description (English)
description.narrative: The DRCJR 2021 will continue to provide multi-sectoral assistance and sustainable solutions in response to community-identified life-saving needs and protection risks through close collaboration and coordination in the Eastern Zone of DRC. Under the DRCJR, multi-sectoral assistance is understood as an individual or community receiving a humanitarian assistance package of at least three sectors. Because it was believed that sharing of resources (office space and transport) and of technical capacity contribute to a greater collaborative impact on beneficiaries. CARE focuses on Food Security & Livelihoods and WASH.
